title: Convenient Enchantments
description: This mod adds 5 simple, useful enchantment to Minecraft.
body:
## This mod adds 5 simple enchantments to Minecraft.

- Lumberjack (Axes): Break one log and the whole tree falls down!
- Vein Miner (Pickaxes): Mines all connected ores of the same type at once!
- Magnet (Chestplate): Attract nearby items towards you!
- Swift Swim (Leggings): Moves at dolphin speed underwater!
- Airbound (Boots, Treasure enchantment): Allows you to double-jump! Reduces fall damage by 80%


---
This is my first ever mod.

Github Repo: https://github.com/MeBadDev/simple-enchantments-mc.git
